searchText: Hopefully a good motivating force towards more decentralization... Or on the other hand centralization to certain hosting providers 😂 Likely they are just blindly assuming that everything related to cryptocurrency means mining on their servers FYI it looks like it's fake news, Hetzner ToS doesn't state that running ETH nodes is banned *The operation of applications for mining cryptocurrencies remains prohibited. These include, but are not limited to, **mining, farming and plotting of cryptocurrencies**. We are entitled to lock the Customer’s access to their Hetzner services or account in the event of non-compliance.* Just mining https://twitter.com/Hetzner_Online/status/1563083561975984130 And this seems to be more of employee incompetence <https://www.reddit.com/r/hetzner/comments/wucxs4/comment/ilfoj8u/> > Even if you just run one node, we consider it a violation of our ToS. https://cryptoleaks.info/case-no-3 Thanks for posting this The videos in there are pretty damning. We have a lot of bad actors in this space No surprise when you get into the billions
